Title: Add OpenAPI spec + request validation middleware
Scope: Publish /openapi.json and enforce schema validation on all P0 endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid payloads return 400 with field-level errors; /openapi.json reflects implemented routes; CI fails on schema-handler drift.

Title: Add pagination + sorting to list endpoints
Scope: Support limit/offset/sort_by/sort_dir on waitlist, pickup events, subsidy claims, and autopay attempts list.
Acceptance Criteria: Deterministic default ordering; response includes count/limit/offset; invalid params return 400 with details.

Title: Add idempotency keys on critical write endpoints
Scope: Add Idempotency-Key support for pickup events, invoice generation, autopay run, subsidy claim/reconcile, and waitlist create.
Acceptance Criteria: Replayed requests within TTL return same logical result; duplicate rows not created; behavior documented in API contract.

Title: Standardize error envelope + correlation ID
Scope: Return unified error payload and request correlation metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: All non-2xx include error.code/error.message/request_id; X-Request-Id returned on every response; request ID logged.

Title: Add per-key rate limiting for protected API routes
Scope: Introduce configurable rate limits by X-API-Key.
Acceptance Criteria: Excess requests return 429 with retry hint; /health excluded; throttle events logged with key hash and route.

Title: Support dual-key API rotation window
Scope: Accept active and next API key concurrently during rotation.
Acceptance Criteria: Both keys work during rotation window; old key can be revoked immediately; rotation runbook updated and tested once.

Title: Add automated end-to-end regression suite
Scope: Cover pickup denied/override, invoice allocation/autopay, subsidy claim/reconcile/summary, waitlist flows, and auth gate behavior.
Acceptance Criteria: Suite runs in CI and blocks merge on failure; includes status and payload assertions for critical flows.

Title: Add workflow freshness endpoint for ops visibility
Scope: Expose status endpoint for critical n8n workflows with last success timestamps.
Acceptance Criteria: Endpoint reports per-workflow last success; flags stale workflows; daily ops script can consume red/yellow/green state.

Title: Complete incident runbook and ownership matrix
Acceptance Criteria: Runbook includes severity levels/responders/escalation path; rollback/recovery commands are copy-paste-ready; incident comms template included.

Title: Add strict data normalization guardrails for Grist writes
Scope: Enforce enum/date/number normalization before write operations.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid enum/date/number rejected with actionable 400; stored statuses canonicalized; backfill script provided for legacy inconsistencies.
